name: float_list_elements
source: Open Nunction Main() { Materials Float V = (1.5, 2.5,); V[1] = 3.25; Print(V[0]); Print(V[1]); }

name: string_list_elements
source: Open Nunction Main() { Materials Weld V = ("one", "two",); V[1] = "three"; Print(V[0]); Print(V[1]); }

name: tuple_adjacent_fields
source: Open Nunction Main() { Ore(Int A, Float B, Weld C, Int D) T = {7, 1.25, "keep", 9}; T.B = 2.5; T.A = 8; Print(T.A); Print(T.B); Print(T.C); Print(T.D); }

name: float_field_interpolation
source: Open Nunction Main() { Ore(Float Value) T = {1.5}; Print(\V"value={T.Value}"); }

name: list_alias_growth
source: Nunction Grow(Materials Int V) { V.Add(20); V.Add(30); V.Add(40); V.Add(50); V.Add(60); } Open Nunction Main() { Materials Int V = (10,); Materials Int Alias = V; Grow(Alias); Print(V.Length); Print(V[0]); Print(V[5]); Alias[0] = 99; Print(V[0]); }

name: list_removal_positions
source: Open Nunction Main() { Materials Int V = (10, 20, 30, 40, 50,); V.Remove(0); V.RemoveAt(1); V.RemoveAt(2); Print(V.Length); Print(V[0]); Print(V[1]); V.Remove(1); V.Remove(0); Print(V.Length); V.Add(70); Print(V[0]); }

name: returned_collections
source: Ore(Int A, Weld B) Make() { Return {7, "keep"}; } Ore[] Array() { Return [10, 20,]; } Materials Int List() { Return (30, 40,); } Open Nunction Main() { Ore(Int A, Weld B) T = Make(); Ore[] A = Array(); Materials Int L = List(); Ore(Int A, Weld B) Other = Make(); L.Add(50); Print(T.A); Print(T.B); Print(A[1]); Print(L[2]); }

name: array_parameter_mutation
source: Nunction Set(Ore[] V) { V[1] = 99; } Open Nunction Main() { Ore[] V = [1, 2,]; Set(V); Print(V[0]); Print(V[1]); }

name: empty_collections
source: Open Nunction Main() { Ore[] A = []; Materials Int B = (); Materials Int new C; Print(A.Length); Print(B.Length); Print(C.Length); B.Add(7); C.Add(8); Print(B[0]); Print(C[0]); }

name: data_multiple_fields
source: Data Pair { Int A; Weld B; } Pair P { P.A = 11; P.B = "keep"; } Open Nunction Main() { Print(P.A); Print(P.B); Print(\V"{P.A}:{P.B}"); }
